name: Coinfaucet.eu (Testnet)
description: Multi-chain testnet faucet dispenses testnet BTC, ETH (Sepolia/Goerli), BNB, MATIC and others. Developer tool — tokens have NO monetary value; rate-limited per IP/wallet.

quickFacts.label: Tokens
quickFacts.value: Testnet BTC, ETH (Sepolia), BNB, MATIC, others

quickFacts.label: Requirement
quickFacts.value: Testnet wallet address; rate-limited per IP/wallet

quickFacts.label: NOT for earning
quickFacts.value: Cannot be sold or converted to real money

pros: Multi-chain — one site for several testnets
cons: Tokens have zero monetary value — not an earning site
Testnets get deprecated (Goerli ended) — verify current chain
reviewData.reviewBody: Coinfaucet.eu is a multi-chain testnet faucet: it dispenses testnet BTC, ETH (Sepolia), BNB, MATIC and other testnet tokens to developers for testing smart contracts and dApps. These tokens have ZERO monetary value — they cannot be sold or converted to real money — and claims are rate-limited per IP/wallet. It is a developer tool, not an earning site. It belongs in a directory only as a dev resource, clearly labelled testnet-only.
reviewData.testNotes: Testnet-only, zero-value model verified 25 Sep 2026. Multi-chain support changes as testnets are deprecated (Goerli ended; Sepolia/Holesky current) — verify current chains. No live test performed.

name: BitcoinFaucet uo1 (Testnet)
description: Bitcoin testnet (testnet3) faucet. Dispenses small amounts of tBTC for testing. Developer tool — zero monetary value. Rate-limited.

pros: Fast funding for testing Bitcoin apps
cons: Bitcoin testnet only — no other chains
reviewData.reviewBody: BitcoinFaucet uo1 is a dedicated Bitcoin testnet (testnet3) faucet dispensing small amounts of tBTC for developers testing Bitcoin wallets/apps. tBTC has zero monetary value and cannot be sold — this is a developer tool, not an earning site. Claims are rate-limited and small. Useful only for Bitcoin development/testing.
reviewData.testNotes: Testnet-only, zero-value model verified 25 Sep 2026. No live test performed.

name: Bitaps tBTC (Testnet)
description: Bitaps block explorer + Bitcoin testnet faucet. Dispenses tBTC for testing. Developer tool — zero monetary value. Rate-limited per address.

pros: Integrated explorer + faucet — convenient for testing
cons: Faucet occasionally drained/rate-limited during high demand
reviewData.reviewBody: Bitaps tBTC is the Bitcoin testnet faucet from Bitaps, an established block-explorer operator. It dispenses small, rate-limited amounts of tBTC (worthless testnet BTC) to developers, with the convenience of an integrated block explorer for verifying test transactions. A developer tool only — no earning potential.
reviewData.testNotes: Testnet-only, zero-value model and Bitaps explorer operator verified 25 Sep 2026. No live test performed.

name: DevWork Testnet3 (Testnet)
description: Bitcoin testnet3 faucet/developer resource. Dispenses tBTC for testing. Developer tool — zero monetary value. Verify current availability; smaller operator.

pros: Additional Bitcoin testnet faucet option when others are drained
reviewData.reviewBody: DevWork Testnet3 is a smaller Bitcoin testnet3 faucet/developer resource dispensing tBTC for testing. As a smaller operator its uptime and availability are less reliable than Bitaps or uo1, and it may be temporarily drained. Worthless testnet tokens only — developer tool, not earning. Use as a backup faucet when the main ones are rate-limited.
reviewData.testNotes: Testnet-only, zero-value model; smaller-operator status noted 25 Sep 2026 — verify current availability. No live test performed.

reviewData.reviewBody: Stakely is a staking-as-a-service provider that also runs testnet faucets for various chains — notably niche Cosmos/Polkadot-ecosystem and L2 testnets that other faucets don't cover. It's marked under_review because faucet availability varies by chain and some have been removed; verify the specific chain you need. Testnet tokens are worthless — developer tool only. Stakely's main (paid) business is staking; faucets are a side service.
reviewData.testNotes: under_review status retained from source; Stakely's staking business and variable testnet-faucet coverage verified 25 Sep 2026. No live test performed.

name: Sepolia Faucet (Testnet)
description: Ethereum Sepolia testnet faucet (PoW-based faucet — one of the most reliable). Dispenses Sepolia ETH for smart-contract testing. Requires mining small PoW or social login; zero monetary value.

quickFacts.label: Faucet type
quickFacts.value: PoW-based (mine small amount) — reliable, no social login needed

quickFacts.label: Alternatives
quickFacts.value: Alchemy, Infura, QuickNode, Chainlink faucets (require login)

quickFacts.label: Trust
quickFacts.value: 70 — one of the most reliable Sepolia faucets

pros: Reliable — less often drained than social-login faucets
Sepolia is the current Ethereum testnet (Goerli deprecated)
cons: PoW mining takes a few minutes of CPU
reviewData.reviewBody: Sepolia Faucet (pk910) is the popular proof-of-work-based Ethereum Sepolia testnet faucet: you mine a small amount of Sepolia ETH with your CPU for a few minutes, avoiding the Twitter/GitHub social login most other Sepolia faucets (Alchemy, Infura, QuickNode, Chainlink) require. Sepolia is the current Ethereum testnet (Goerli was deprecated). Sepolia ETH has zero monetary value — developer tool only. It's one of the most reliable Sepolia faucets because PoW resists abuse.
reviewData.testNotes: PoW-based Sepolia faucet and Goerli deprecation verified 25 Sep 2026. Testnet tokens zero value. No live test performed.

pros: Amoy is the current testnet (Mumbai deprecated)
reviewData.reviewBody: Polygon Faucet is the official Polygon Amoy testnet faucet (the old Mumbai testnet was deprecated). It dispenses small, rate-limited amounts of testnet POL/MATIC for Polygon dApp development, typically requiring a wallet and social verification (GitHub/Twitter). Testnet tokens have zero monetary value — developer tool only. Official and reliable for Polygon development.
reviewData.testNotes: Amoy testnet (Mumbai deprecated) and official faucet verified 25 Sep 2026 against Polygon docs. Testnet tokens zero value. No live test performed.

name: Sol Faucet (Testnet)
description: Official Solana devnet/testnet faucet. Dispenses SOL devnet tokens for Solana program testing. CLI or web; zero monetary value. Rate-limited per public key.

reviewData.reviewBody: Sol Faucet is the official Solana devnet/testnet faucet, accessible via web UI or CLI (solana airdrop). It dispenses devnet SOL (rate-limited per public key) for testing Solana programs and dApps. Devnet SOL has zero monetary value — developer tool only. Official and fast, thanks to Solana's fast finality. Devnet occasionally resets, so test balances can be wiped.
reviewData.testNotes: Official Solana devnet faucet and CLI airdrop verified 25 Sep 2026 against Solana docs. Testnet tokens zero value. No live test performed.

reviewData.reviewBody: Atleta TAP is the testnet faucet for Atleta Network, a newer/smaller L1, dispensing testnet TAP tokens. As a newer chain with limited documentation and community, faucet reliability and even continued operation are less certain — verify current availability before relying on it. Testnet tokens are worthless — developer tool only, and only useful if you're specifically building on Atleta.
reviewData.testNotes: Atleta Network testnet faucet; newer/smaller-chain status noted 25 Sep 2026 — verify current availability. Testnet tokens zero value. No live test performed.

quickFacts.label: Tokens
quickFacts.value: Multi-chain testnet tokens — zero monetary value

reviewData.reviewBody: Faucet Trade Bot is a Telegram bot dispensing multi-chain testnet tokens — convenient Telegram-native access, no browser or account beyond Telegram. As a smaller Telegram-bot operator, reliability is unproven and the bot could stop or be cloned for phishing — always verify the official handle. Testnet tokens are worthless — developer tool only. Use as a convenience, with official chain faucets (Sepolia, Solana, Polygon) as primary.
reviewData.testNotes: Telegram-bot testnet faucet; smaller-operator risk noted 25 Sep 2026 — verify official handle and reliability. Testnet tokens zero value. No live test performed.
